  enabled: false

variables:
- name: artifactDirName
  value: app
- name: greeting
  value: hello-from-pipeline
stages:
- stage: build
  variables:
  - name: stageLabel
    value: build-stage
  jobs:
  - job: compile
    variables:
    - name: greeting
      value: hello-from-job
    steps:
    - task: CmdLine@2
      name: stage
      displayName: Stage build output
      inputs:
        script: |
          mkdir -p "$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/$(artifactDirName)"
          echo "built" > "$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/$(artifactDirName)/build.txt"
          test -d "$(Build.BinariesDirectory)" || { echo "Build.BinariesDirectory is missing"; exit 3; }
          echo "E2E-MARKER staged build.txt"
          echo "E2E-MARKER pipeline variable stageLabel=$(stageLabel)"
          echo "E2E-MARKER job variable wins greeting=$(greeting)"
          echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=artifactName;isOutput=true]app"
    - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
      displayName: Publish the staged directory
      inputs:
        targetPath: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/$(artifactDirName)
        artifactName: drop
  - job: verify
    dependsOn:
    - compile
    condition: eq(dependencies.compile.outputs['stage.artifactName'], 'app')
    steps:
    - task: 6d15af64-176c-496d-b583-fd2ae21d4df4@1
      condition: false
      inputs:
        repository: none
    - task: 30f35852-3f7e-4c0c-9a88-e127b4f97211@1
      inputs:
        alias: current
        artifact: drop
    - task: CmdLine@2
      displayName: Confirm the output variable crossed and the artifact arrived
      inputs:
        script: |
          test -f "$(Pipeline.Workspace)/drop/build.txt" || {
            echo "downloaded artifact is missing"; exit 3;
          }
          echo "E2E-MARKER cross-job output variable is app"
          echo "E2E-MARKER downloaded artifact content is $(cat "$(Pipeline.Workspace)/drop/build.txt")"
  - job: must_not_run
    dependsOn:
    - compile
    condition: eq(dependencies.compile.outputs['stage.artifactName'], 'not-the-value')
    steps:
    - task: 6d15af64-176c-496d-b583-fd2ae21d4df4@1
      condition: false
      inputs:
        repository: none
    - task: CmdLine@2
      displayName: Never reached
      inputs:
        script: echo "E2E-MARKER must not appear"
